mapper.select: INSERT INTO user_memories (user_id, content, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, TRUE, NOW(), NOW()) RETURNING id, user_id, content, is_active, created_at, updated_at
SELECT id, user_id, content, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM user_memories WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
